title: Pure Ice Barrier
summary: Ice Barrier cards with one generic WATER Synchro and generic staples. Revealer of the Ice Barrier discards to summon an Ice Barrier Tuner from the Deck, General Wayne searches the Spells and Traps, and Speaker and Georgius summon themselves next to another Ice Barrier, so the Synchros come out quickly. Each Ice Barrier monster locks the opponent in some way while another one is on the field: no Tribute Summons, no GY effects, no changing battle positions. The 2024 cards lead. Mirror Mage of the Ice Barrier tributes a monster for three Tokens, and searches any Ice Barrier card when it goes to the GY. Georgius summons a Level 5 or lower Ice Barrier and stops GY effects. Frozen Domain of the Ice Barrier stops responses to Ice Barrier monster effects. Lancea, Ancestral Dragon of the Ice Mountain, a generic WATER Synchro, summons an Ice Barrier each time the opponent Special Summons. Ekhajar is not out in the TCG yet.
